use_case_name: Publish Air and Surface Surveillance Tracks

claims.content: The C2 JU completes sufficient reporting responsibility checks, correlation, and data registration for air or surface tracks.

missing_aspects: The claim asserts that the system is 'permitted to begin transmitting' after these checks. The cited evidence only establishes a prohibition ('shall not transmit') until the checks are performed; it does not explicitly state that completion of checks grants permission or triggers transmission.

claims.content: After successful publication of an Inactive or Limited Status IU track, the C2 JU has reported it as a track or point on the Surveillance Network PG with Identity reported as Friend.
The PPLI Track Number and Identity Indicator are reported as value 1, and are maintained if another C2 JU assumes reporting responsibility (R2) of the IU.
A new local track with no tentative correlation on the initial correlation test has been transmitted.
A new local track that tentatively correlates on the initial test but fails correlation on the next test has been transmitted.

If the automatic correlation test fails during execution, the system has assigned a new Track Number (TN B) to the local track and reported TN B in a J3.2 or J3.3 message with an initial ID of Pending.
The C2 JU is in Active status, having either initially achieved Active status or returned to Active status from Inactive status or TDS Failure.
The C2 JU is capable of assuming reporting responsibility (R²) for air, surface, or land tracks.
The C2 JU wants to transmit air and surface surveillance tracks after sufficient reporting responsibility checks, correlation, and data registration are performed.

scope_contract.goal_statement: The C2 JU wants to transmit air and surface surveillance tracks after sufficient reporting responsibility checks, correlation, and data registration are performed.
scope_contract.canonical_success_scenario: A single C2 JU, having completed sufficient reporting responsibility checks, correlation, and data registration, transmits one air or surface track, thereby publishing it, and exercises automatic decorrelation when the track is a real-time air or surface track.
scope_contract.start_boundary: The C2 JU has completed sufficient reporting responsibility checks, correlation, and data registration and is ready to transmit the air or surface track.
scope_contract.success_boundary: The air or surface track has been transmitted/published as a surveillance track, with automatic decorrelation applied for real-time tracks.
in_scope_actions: Apply automatic decorrelation when initiating real-time air or surface tracks
excluded_adjacent_actions: Performing reporting responsibility checks, correlation, and data registration (upstream prerequisite)
Common tracking (sharing a common track number and shifting R2 between C2 JUs)
Assuming reporting responsibility for land tracks

missing_aspects: The claim includes 'using its automatic decorrelation capability when initiating real-time air or surface tracks', but EC-G-001 only states that C² JUs shall have such a capability — it does not state that the system uses this capability as part of the transmission goal or process. No cited card supports the inclusion of decorrelation as an action taken during or for the purpose of publishing tracks in this context.
